name: Celestial Peak
storyline: Enma's seal was only the first lock. Above the Peak, the Five Heavens are coming undone, and each one is home to a field boss and a colossal boss that awakens every hour. Climb from the cherry blossom valley to the sea of clouds across fifteen open regions of a mythic Japan, form a party, and take down Enma-Oni and the giants awakening beyond the Peak.
summary: Celestial Peak is a free-to-play anime-style action MMORPG set in a mythic Japan. Starting in Kazemura Village, players climb from cherry blossom fields through cedar forests, volcanic slopes and a sea of clouds toward the summit, where the seal binding Enma-Oni, the Lord of the Crimson Inferno, is breaking. Combat is real-time and skill-based, built around manual aiming, timed perfect parries, skill chaining and a Spirit Gauge that unleashes each class's ultimate skill. Players choose between three base weapons (katana, bow or staff) and branch into a tree of 93 classes across 100 levels. The game features 15 open regions, 7 dungeons with timed rankings, hourly open-world colossal bosses, parties of up to 5, guilds, a PvP arena, crafting, a player market, mounts and Kosei companion spirits.
